answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on three representative tasks: machine translation with noisy training target, unsupervised text style transfer (only weak references are available), and non-autoregressive generation with flexible generation order.

answer_2.quote: We use both BLEU and BLEURT, an advanced model-based metric, as the automatic metrics for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We also perform human evaluations on Yelp data to further test the transfer quality. ... three annotators are asked to evaluate which sentence is preferred as the transferred sentence of the original sentence, in terms of content preservation and sentiment transfer.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose the preferred output (or indicate tie) based on content preservation and sentiment transfer.
